# Interface IProcesses

Gives access to processes.

###### Namespace: TopSolid.Cad.Design.Automating

###### Assembly: TopSolid.Cad.Design.Automating.dll

##### Syntax

```
[ServiceContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 19, 400, 140)]
public interface IProcesses
```

##### Remarks

This interface is available since v7.19.400.140

### Methods 

|  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|   DefineProcess(DocumentId, ElementId, DocumentId, bool)  |  Method to define a process  |  
 
|   FindFunctionProcesses(DocumentId)  |  Finds available processes from a function document  |  
 
|   FindLocalProcesses(DocumentId)  |  Finds local processes of a document  |  
 
|   GetProcess(DocumentId)  |  Gets process associated to a document  |  
 
|   GetProcessDefinitionDocument(ElementId)  |  Gets process definition document  |
